name: University of North Carolina System & Community Colleges
source_citation: UNC System Strategic Plan (Higher Expectations) & NC Community Colleges Vision 2030
mission: To discover, create, transmit, and apply knowledge to address the grand challenges of North Carolina and the world, and train a high-skilled, resilient workforce for the state's emerging industries.
eligible_applicant_types: Public and State controlled institutions of higher education

goals.title: STEM Research, Advanced Materials, and Energy Innovation
goals.citation: UNC System Research Roadmap, Pillars 1 & 2 (Materials & Energy)
goals.description: Lead breakthrough scientific discoveries in clean semiconductors, battery chemistries, quantum computing, and agricultural biotechnology across state research hubs.
objectives: Secure federal university-industry cooperative research centers (IUCRC / EPSCoR)
Advance solid-state battery and wide-bandgap semiconductor R&D with federal labs
Modernize shared university supercomputing and nanotechnology cleanrooms

goals.title: Biomedical Discovery, Cancer Research, and Rural Healthcare Workforce
goals.citation: UNC Health Sciences Consortium Plan & Rural Residency Initiative
goals.description: Drive translational clinical research in oncology, genomics, neurodegenerative disease, and train rural physicians, nurse practitioners, and allied health professionals.
objectives: Expand NIH clinical and translational science awards (CTSA)
Establish community-based clinical trial networks in eastern and western NC
Fund rural medical residency and nurse practitioner clinical training pipelines

goals.title: Advanced Manufacturing Workforce, Apprenticeships, and Dual Enrollment
goals.citation: NC Community Colleges Fast Track to Jobs & Career & College Promise
goals.description: Align 58 community college technical degrees with aerospace, electric vehicle, pharmaceutical, and clean tech manufacturing investments arriving in North Carolina.
objectives: Equip mechatronics and clean energy training labs across regional community colleges
Expand registered apprenticeships and employer-recognized industry credentials
Scale K-12 dual-enrollment STEM pathways for first-generation college students
